source: openmc (corrected RBMK channel cell, MGXS; openmc/rbmk_graphite_mgxs.py)
note: Fractional change of each homogenised 2-group constant per KELVIN of graphite temperature. Measured as the chord slope over 600-800 K (the range the S(alpha,beta) tables cover); the Java scaling factor is anchored at the core's nominal graphite temperature (600 degC = 873.15 K) so the correction is a perturbation about the nominal state. The effect is thermal scattering: up-scatter ss21 and fast removal sr1 grow as the graphite heats, so k_inf RISES -- the RBMK's POSITIVE graphite coefficient. SIGN is sourced (INSAG-7 Table II-I, NUREG-1250). MAGNITUDE is to_verify: it is a chord slope extrapolated ~73 K to the operating point, and the ss21/ss12 slopes are nonlinear (they weaken at higher T), so this overestimates the effect at 873 K.
